input_kind: synthetic; no LLM API; no business data

requirements.name: typed_multimodal_message
requirements.acceptance: Text plus image artifact reference survive state serialization; no claim of vision-model quality.

requirements.name: deterministic_and_router_nodes
requirements.acceptance: A fixed transform runs without an LLM; a simulated cheap model routes to only allowlisted branches; invalid route is rejected or escalated.

requirements.name: parallel_join
requirements.acceptance: Two branch tasks overlap and join; visible outputs retain branch identity.

requirements.name: pause_resume_new_process
requirements.acceptance: Pause before a simulated effect, exit, resume in a new OS process, and retain prior results.

requirements.name: fork_from_prior_node
requirements.acceptance: Create a new branch from a saved earlier state with changed input; original completed/rejected trajectory remains queryable and unchanged.

requirements.name: reject_branch_effect_gate
requirements.acceptance: Rejected trajectory does not execute publish; selected passing trajectory may commit one simulated effect.

requirements.name: replay_effect_idempotency
requirements.acceptance: Inject process exit after committing effect but before node completion; recover without duplicate effect. Attribute idempotency to application if custom.

requirements.name: visible_event_identity
requirements.acceptance: Node start/result/error or equivalent persisted observations have run/node/attempt/branch identity; never claim hidden reasoning capture.

reporting.rule: Keep the same acceptance requirements. Unexecuted functionality is not a pass; custom support is not attributed to the framework. Preserve errors and versions.
